children: Japan's economy minister Minoru Kiuchi said on Tuesday he respects the central bank's independence in setting monetary policy as stipulated by law.
Kiuchi, seen as among the reflationist allies of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, also said he hoped to attend the Bank of Japan's next policy meeting on October 29-30 if the schedule permits.
Kiuchi made the remarks during a news conference after a regular cabinet meeting.
